image_description: A vintage black Remington Noiseless typewriter sitting on a wooden desk. The image focuses on the keyboard and carriage area. A sheet of white paper is loaded into the platen. To the left, there are papers and a blue sticky note with handwriting. The keyboard features round, glass-topped keys with metal rims. The space bar is the long, horizontal lever at the bottom center of the keybed.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is significantly longer than the circular letter keys, visually appearing to be roughly 8-10 times their diameter.

The metal lever arm on the left seems to merge indistinctly with the background papers and the typewriter body, lacking clear mechanical definition or connection points.
The alignment of the circular keys shows slight waviness in the rows, suggesting minor geometric inconsistency in the grid structure.
